answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the vertex seed, the thread timing is verifiable from the garden record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 67 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is trivial once and expensive in bulk. A farm that wants 98 keys as a result forfeits 98 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
